daily.title: RBI’s Rohit Jain wants primary dealers to become architects of G-Sec market development
daily.summary: Jain said primary dealers could contribute towards building a partnership that continues to serve the government securities market well. Subhana Shaikh Published 24 Nov 2026, 01:08 PM IST MUMBAI: Primary dealers (PDs) must evolve from participants in the government securities market to active architects of market development, Reserve Bank of India deputy governor Rohit Jain said. “The scale of government borrowing today is larger, and so is the importance of the market-making role that the PDs play,” Jain said at the Primary Dealers’ Association of India Seminar 2026 in Mumbai on Monday.

daily.title: Bank Holiday in Bengaluru, Karnataka on Friday 27 November 2026: Branches to remain closed — Here is why | RBI calendar
daily.summary: The RBI designated November 27 as the “Holiday under the Negotiable Instruments Act” in Bengaluru, Karnataka. Banks will remain closed in Bengaluru, Karnataka on Friday, November 27, according to the Reserve Bank of India calendar. Meanwhile, HDFC Bank's calendar states that banks will closed across Karnataka on November 27. Banks will be closed in Karnataka on November 27 on the occasion of Kanakadasa Jayanthi. The day is observed to commemorate the birth anniversary of the revered poet, philosopher, composer, and social reformer Shri Kanaka Dasa.

daily.title: GST e-Invoicing for RCM Self-Invoices: RCMDOM & RCMIMP Mandatory from 1 January 2027
daily.summary: GST e-invoicing for RCM self-invoices begins on 1 January 2027. Know RCMDOM, RCMIMP, turnover threshold, IRN generation and ERP readiness requirements. Summary: The GST e-invoicing framework is being extended to recipient-generated self-invoices relating to domestic supplies received from unregistered persons under the Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCMDOM) and imports of services (RCMIMP), with effect from 1 January 2027. Notification No. 04/2026-Central Tax dated 26 October 2026 extends the existing e-invoicing framework to these transactions, while Notification No. 05/2026-Central Tax introduces corresponding amendments to the CGST Rules and e-invoice schema.

daily.title: Travel agents ask Malaysia govt to extend visa free entry for Indian tourists
daily.summary: A travel agents association from Malaysia has asked its government to extend its visa free entry for Indian tourists citing risks to air connectivity, tourism and wider economy. The appeal follows Malaysian government’s decision to end visa free entry for Indians from January 1, 2027. “India is one of Malaysia’s most important source markets. Letting the exemption expire now risks slowing the progress Malaysia has made in attracting visitors from India,” said Nigel Wong, President of Malaysian Association of Tour and Travel Agents.

daily.title: Delhi ITAT Reduces Expense Disallowance From One-Fourth to One-Sixth
daily.summary: Delhi ITAT reduced the gross profit estimate from 35% to 26.68% and restricted the ad hoc expense disallowance from one-fourth to one-sixth. When the Assessing Officer rejects the books under section 145(3) , how far can he increase the gross profit rate and separately disallow expenses? In this case, the assessee declared a gross profit rate of 21.61% . The Assessing Officer substituted 35% and also disallowed one-fourth of the expenses , excluding audit fees.

The domestic stock markets are closed on Tuesday, November 24, on account of Prakash Gurpurb Sri Guru Nanak Dev (Guru Nanak Jayanti), with trading suspended on both the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and the National Stock Exchange (NSE). daily.title: NSEL releases ₹1,950 cr in one-time settlement, ends 14-yr payment default
daily.summary: The National Spot Exchange Ltd (NSEL) on Monday said it has released a one-time settlement (OTS) payout of Rs 1,950 crore to eligible claimants, bringing closure to the Rs 5,600 crore payment default crisis after nearly 14 years of legal battle. The Mumbai bench of the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) had approved the settlement scheme. The full amount was deposited in a settlement account, with payouts to eligible specified creditors scheduled for November 23, 2026. The money was paid to 63 Moons Technologies, which acted as assignee of the specified creditors.

daily.title: India's gold imports fall 40% to $24.7 billion in April-October 2026: CTI
daily.summary: Gold imports into India declined by around 40 per cent in April-October this year compared to the corresponding period last year, with the country purchasing gold worth USD 24.7 billion during the seven months, Chamber of Trade and Industry (CTI) Chairman Brijesh Goyal said on Monday. According to Goyal, India imported gold worth USD 41.24 billion between April and October 2025, while the figure stood at USD 24.7 billion during the same period this year, marking a decline of USD 16.46 billion. He said the figures reflected a significant reduction in gold purchases during the current financial year.

The latest hike marks Audi India's second price revision in 2026, as the automaker had previously raised prices by up to 2 per cent across its model range from April 1 this year. The price revision will be applicable across its model range, the company said in a statement.

breaking.title: China sentences official to death for spying, leaking national secrets
breaking.summary: A Chinese official has been sentenced to death for spying for a foreign country, a government-linked publisher said on Monday. Gold Wall Press, a publishing company associated with China's National Administration of State Secrets Protection, said the convicted person was surnamed Ma and was approached and recruited by a foreign intelligence service while working abroad. Chinese courts typically do not publish information about state security cases, but in recent years the powerful Ministry of State Security and Gold Wall Press have increasingly publicised arrests as well as using social media, movies and comics to promote warnings about espionage.
